_what: DEMO (needs the LOCAL image store -- deliberately NOT part of the offline demo set; flowmirror demo never runs it): runs/demo_three_arm.json plus images_root/image_pick, proving the three arms genuinely differ. The TV arm resolves <images_root>/<image_id> and attaches the file only after its sha256 matches the pool's image_sha256 (missing file -> image_missing note, hash mismatch -> image_sha_mismatch note; both degrade that impression to text); T stays pure text, TC stays OCR + frozen caption with no pixels; TV impressions log img_idx on the imp row. images_root below is the one sanctioned machine-local absolute path in a tracked run config: it points at the pre-resized image store inside the sibling fundmarket-sim checkout (sim/content_pool_v1/images -- flat, 0-based, 801 files; every pool image_id resolves there with an exact sha256 match, all 801 verified). Edit it to wherever that store lives on your machine; never copy images into this repo. Synthetic NAVs as in runs/demo_three_arm.json -- demonstration only, never for empirical claims. Example: python -m flowmirror.engine.loop runs/demo_three_arm_images.json --mock --days 5 --agents 60 --out runs/out/imgs --replay-check
